title.en: Li Bai, Du Fu and Gao Shi travel through Liang and Song
title.zh: 李白、杜甫与高适同游梁宋

summary.en: In 744, Du Fu met Li Bai, then travelled with him and Gao Shi through Liang and Song, around present-day Kaifeng and Shangqiu. The meeting is placed at Luoyang or possibly Chenliu. Du Fu and Li Bai travelled together again in Shandong in 745 before parting at the end of that year.
summary.zh: 744年，杜甫结识李白，随后与李白、高适同游梁宋，即今开封、商丘一带。相遇地点一般记为洛阳，也可能是陈留。745年，杜甫与李白又同游山东，至年底分别。

dateNote.en: 744 marks their meeting and Liang–Song travels; their Shandong journey followed in 745.
dateNote.zh: 744年为相识及同游梁宋之年；山东之游在745年。

title.en: Yan Zhenqing writes a requiem for his nephew
title.zh: 颜真卿书写《祭侄文稿》

summary.en: After Yan Gaoqing and his son Jiming died resisting the An Lushan rebels, Yan Zhenqing sent his elder nephew Quanming to recover their remains. In 758 he wrote a requiem for Jiming. The surviving draft preserves crossed-out words and shifts from regular to running and cursive script, bringing a family’s wartime loss into the history of calligraphy.
summary.zh: 颜杲卿与儿子季明在抵抗安史叛军时遇难后，颜真卿派长侄泉明前往收殓遗骸。758年，他为季明写下祭文。传世文稿保留涂改字句，楷、行、草笔法交织，使一个家族的战乱创痛留在了书法史中。

dateNote.en: Dated in the manuscript to the third day of the ninth lunar month, Qianyuan 1 (758).
dateNote.zh: 文稿自署乾元元年（758）九月初三，为农历日期。

title.en: Laoshang Chanyu raids through Xiaoguan
title.zh: 老上单于率军入萧关

summary.en: In 166 BCE, Laoshang Chanyu led a Xiongnu incursion through Chaona and Xiaoguan. The Shiji reports 140,000 cavalry, raids reaching Pengyang, and advance riders reaching Yong and Ganquan. Emperor Wen mobilized forces near Chang’an and along the frontier; the Xiongnu withdrew after more than a month.
summary.zh: 前166年，老上单于率匈奴军入朝那、萧关。《史记》记其骑兵十四万，进至彭阳，前哨抵雍、甘泉。汉文帝调兵驻守长安附近及边郡；匈奴军在塞内停留月余后撤走。

dateNote.en: 166 BCE is Emperor Wen’s year 14. Zhou Yafu’s Xiliu deployment belongs to a separate incursion in 158 BCE.
dateNote.zh: 前166年为汉文帝十四年；周亚夫驻细柳属于前158年的另一次边患。

labelI18n.zh: 固原附近的萧关地区（参考点）

title.en: Cao Cao selects surrendered troops for the Qingzhou army
title.zh: 曹操从黄巾降卒中选编青州兵

summary.en: In 192, after Liu Dai’s death, Cao Cao took charge of Yan province and pursued the Qingzhou Yellow Turbans to Jibei. The Sanguozhi records the surrender of more than 300,000 soldiers that winter. Cao Cao selected their elite troops to form the force known as the Qingzhou army; the text gives no number for that selected force.
summary.zh: 192年，刘岱死后，曹操领兖州牧，追击青州黄巾至济北。《三国志》记当年冬季受降士卒三十余万；曹操从中选取精锐，号为“青州兵”，并未记载所选部队的人数。

dateNote.en: 192 is Chuping 3; the surrender is recorded in winter.
dateNote.zh: 192年为初平三年，受降记于当年冬季。

labelI18n.zh: 山东今兖州（区域参考点）

note.en: Distinguished all surrendered soldiers from the smaller selected force. Retained the modern Yanzhou coordinate as a regional reference; removed the Chinese label’s unsupported identification of this point as Changyi or the recruitment site.
note.zh: 区分降卒总数与其中所选部队。保留今兖州坐标作区域参考，删除把此点标为昌邑或编军地点的含义。

title.en: Liu Xiu becomes emperor, then establishes his capital at Luoyang
title.zh: 刘秀称帝后定都洛阳

summary.en: In 25 CE, Liu Xiu took the imperial title at an altar south of Hao, at Qianqiuting Wuchengmo, inaugurating the Jianwu era. Later that year he entered Luoyang and established his capital there. The Hou Hanshu places the accession in the sixth lunar month and the move to Luoyang in the tenth.
summary.zh: 25年，刘秀在鄗南千秋亭五成陌设坛即皇帝位，建元建武。同年稍后，他进入洛阳并定都于此。《后汉书》将即位记于农历六月，将入洛阳定都记于十月。

dateNote.en: Both events fall in 25 CE. Luoyang anchors the establishment of the capital, not the accession ceremony.
dateNote.zh: 两事均在25年；洛阳锚点对应定都，不是即位仪式地点。

labelI18n.zh: 洛阳（都城参考点）

note.en: Corrected accession at Luoyang to accession south of Hao followed by establishment of the capital at Luoyang. Retained the city reference coordinate; it does not locate the Han palace or the accession altar.

title.en: Emperor Yang begins the Eastern Capital and Tongji Canal
title.zh: 隋炀帝营建东京，开通济渠

summary.en: In 605, Emperor Yang ordered construction of an eastern capital at Luoyang and the opening of the Tongji Canal. The Sui shu describes waterways linking the Luoyang area to the Yellow River and onward toward the Huai. It records the capital’s completion in 606 and orders for the separate Yongji Canal, extending north toward Zhuo commandery, in 608.
summary.zh: 605年，隋炀帝诏建东京洛阳，并开通济渠。《隋书》记水道自洛阳一带达黄河，再向淮河连通；东京于606年建成，另向北通往涿郡的永济渠则在608年奉诏开凿。

dateNote.en: 605 dates the orders for the Eastern Capital and Tongji Canal. The capital was completed in 606; Yongji was ordered in 608.
dateNote.zh: 605年对应营建东京与开通济渠的诏令；东京606年建成，永济渠608年奉诏开凿。

labelI18n.zh: 洛阳（东都参考点）

note.en: Separated Tongji (605) from Yongji (608), and distinguished the 605 construction order from the capital’s completion in 606. The city reference does not plot either canal’s full course.
note.zh: 区分通济渠（605）与永济渠（608），并分开605年营建诏令与606年东京建成。城市参考点不表示两渠的完整线路。

title.en: Emperor Yang is besieged at Yanmen
title.zh: 隋炀帝被围雁门

summary.en: In 615, Shibi Khan’s Turkic forces besieged Emperor Yang at Yanmen. The emperor called on the commanderies for reinforcements; the besiegers withdrew the following lunar month. In a later stage of the rebellions, Li Mi and Zhai Rang seized Xingluo granary at Luokou in 617 and opened its grain stores to the people.
summary.zh: 615年，始毕可汗的突厥军将隋炀帝围于雁门。炀帝诏令诸郡发兵救援，围军于次月撤去。此后叛乱继续发展，李密、翟让于617年攻取洛口的兴洛仓，开仓让民众取粮。

dateNote.en: 615 anchors the Yanmen siege (Daye 11). The granary seizure was in 617 (Daye 13), two years later.
dateNote.zh: 615年锚定雁门之围（大业十一年）；夺仓在两年后的617年（大业十三年）。

labelI18n.zh: 雁门地区（围城事件参考点）

note.en: Corrected the interval to two years and made Yanmen the focal event. The retained coordinate is a Yanmen regional reference, not Luokou and not a verified siege-wall location. The later granary event is explicitly dated.

title.en: Lin Zexu supervises the destruction of opium at Humen
title.zh: 林则徐主持虎门销烟

summary.en: In 1839, imperial commissioner Lin Zexu supervised the destruction of confiscated opium at Humen. The drug was mixed with salt water and lime and released into the sea. His reported tally, quoted in Hummel’s biographical dictionary, was 19,179 chests and 2,119 bags.
summary.zh: 1839年，钦差大臣林则徐在虎门主持销毁收缴的鸦片，将其拌入盐水、石灰后排入海中。恒慕义主编的人物传记辞典引述林则徐所报销毁数，为19,179箱、2,119袋。

dateNote.en: 1839 dates the destruction at Humen; the tally distinguishes chests from bags.
dateNote.zh: 1839年为虎门销烟之年；数量分别以箱、袋计。

labelI18n.zh: 广东虎门（海岸参考点）

title.en: Nurhaci is defeated at Ningyuan
title.zh: 努尔哈赤攻宁远受挫

summary.en: In early 1626, Yuan Chonghuan’s Ming defenders repelled Nurhaci’s assault on Ningyuan with the help of newly mounted foreign cannon. Nurhaci died later that year, and Hong Taiji succeeded him as khan.
summary.zh: 1626年初，袁崇焕率明军守宁远，借助新置西洋火炮击退努尔哈赤的进攻。努尔哈赤于同年稍后去世，皇太极继汗位。

dateNote.en: The Ningyuan battle, Nurhaci’s death and Hong Taiji’s succession all fall in 1626.
dateNote.zh: 宁远之战、努尔哈赤去世与皇太极继位均在1626年。

title.en: The Chongzhen Emperor has Yuan Chonghuan executed
title.zh: 崇祯帝处死袁崇焕

summary.en: Yuan Chonghuan returned to defend Beijing during Hong Taiji’s invasion, but was arrested and executed in 1630. Hummel’s dictionary records charges of collusion with the enemy and the killing of Mao Wenlong. Its Hong Taiji biography attributes the claim that spies supplied evidence against Yuan to Qing official accounts.
summary.zh: 皇太极入侵时，袁崇焕回援北京，却被捕并于1630年遭处死。恒慕义主编的人物传记辞典记其所受指控包括通敌及杀毛文龙；其中皇太极传将间谍提供袁崇焕罪证的说法明确归于清方官方记载。

title.en: Xie An accepts office under Huan Wen
title.zh: 谢安接受桓温征召出仕

summary.en: After repeatedly declining appointments while living in Kuaiji, Xie An joined Huan Wen’s staff in 360. The Jinshu says he was already over forty when he decided to pursue office after his brother Xie Wan’s dismissal.
summary.zh: 谢安寓居会稽期间多次辞谢征辟，360年接受桓温征召入幕。《晋书》记载，弟弟谢万被黜后，他才有意出仕，当时已四十余岁。

title.en: Huo Qubing campaigns in the Hexi corridor

summary.en: In spring and summer 121 BCE, Huo Qubing led campaigns against the Xiongnu in the Hexi region. The Shiji traces the spring advance past the Yanzhi Mountains and the summer expedition toward Juyan and the Qilian Mountains.

summary.en: In 260 BCE, Bai Qi’s Qin army defeated Zhao’s forces at Changping. The Shiji reports that 400,000 surrendered soldiers were killed, apart from 240 younger men sent back. These figures belong to its account of the catastrophe.

title.zh: 郑成功开始进攻荷兰统治下的台湾

title.en: Huang Gongwang inscribes his unfinished Fuchun Mountains scroll
title.zh: 黄公望为尚未完成的《富春山居图》题记

summary.en: Huang Gongwang began this river landscape in 1347 for his companion Zheng Wuyong. In his 1350 inscription he wrote that, after three or four years, it was still unfinished. He had taken the scroll back into his travelling baggage and intended to continue when time allowed. The surviving Wuyongshi scroll combines successive stretches of riverbank, trees and mountains; the featured image shows one photographed section. The original was later damaged by fire and divided.

title.en: Tao Yuanming leaves office at Pengze
title.zh: 陶渊明辞去彭泽令

summary.en: In 405, Tao Yuanming resigned after a short term as magistrate of Pengze and returned home. His own account and later biographies explain the decision differently. His withdrawal became central to the later image of the poet living close to the land.
summary.zh: 405年，陶渊明短暂担任彭泽令后辞官归乡。他本人的叙述与后世传记，对辞官缘由有不同解释；归隐田园成为后世陶渊明形象的重要内容。

dateNote.en: 405 dates the departure from office, not the composition of Drinking V.

title.en: Sun Quan moves his capital from Wuchang to Jianye
title.zh: 孙权由武昌迁都建业

summary.en: Sun Quan became emperor at Wuchang in the fourth lunar month of 229. In the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye, present-day Nanjing, leaving his heir Sun Deng at Wuchang with Lu Xun’s assistance.
summary.zh: 229年农历四月，孙权在武昌称帝；九月迁都建业，即今南京，留太子孙登镇守武昌，由陆逊辅佐。

dateNote.en: Both events fall in 229; the map marks Jianye, the later capital, not the accession site.
dateNote.zh: 两事均在229年；地图标示迁入的建业，不是称帝地点。

note.en: Correct the sequence and distinguish historical Wuchang (Ezhou) from modern Wuhan’s Wuchang district.
note.zh: 纠正先后顺序；史文武昌为今鄂州，不应混同今武汉市武昌区。

title.en: Shao prefecture becomes Baoqing prefecture
title.zh: 邵州升为宝庆府

summary.en: Emperor Lizong succeeded to the Song throne in 1224. His Baoqing era began in 1225, when Shao prefecture was elevated to Baoqing prefecture, at present-day Shaoyang. Lizong had previously held the title of Shaozhou defence commissioner.
summary.zh: 宋理宗于1224年即位，1225年改元宝庆，并将邵州升为宝庆府，即今邵阳。理宗此前曾获授邵州防御使。

dateNote.en: 1225 dates the era change and prefecture elevation; the accession was in 1224.
dateNote.zh: 1225年指改元与升府；即位在1224年。

title.en: Wang Zhi inspects the northeastern frontier
title.zh: 汪直巡察东北边疆

summary.en: In 1479, Wang Zhi inspected the northeastern frontier. The Mingshi biography next describes him supervising a campaign commanded by Zhu Yong against Jianzhou Jurchens. His earlier rise had been tied to the Western Depot, established under his leadership in 1477.
summary.zh: 1479年，汪直巡察东北边疆。《明史》本传随后叙述朱永统兵、汪直监军，对建州女真用兵。汪直此前因西厂而得势；西厂于1477年设立，由他掌领。

dateNote.en: 1479 dates the recorded frontier tour; the following campaign narrative is not assigned a separate exact date here.
dateNote.zh: 1479年指史书所记巡边；其后叙述的战役不另定精确日期。

labelI18n.zh: 辽东、建州一带：战役区域参考点

title.en: Ming forces withdraw after the Lam Son victories
title.zh: 蓝山军获胜后，明军撤退

summary.en: After Lam Son victories in 1427, Ming commanders agreed to withdraw from Vietnam. Le Loi became emperor in 1428, founding the Later Le dynasty. Withdrawal and dynastic foundation belong to successive years.
summary.zh: 1427年蓝山军获胜后，明军将领议和撤出越南。黎利于1428年称帝，开创后黎朝；撤军与建朝分属前后两年。

dateNote.en: 1427 anchors the agreement and withdrawal sequence; 1428 dates Le Loi’s accession.
dateNote.zh: 1427年为议和撤军过程的时间锚点；黎利称帝在1428年。

note.en: Separate withdrawal from foundation; no claim that all troops crossed the border on one converted Gregorian day.
note.zh: 区分撤军与建朝，不断言所有军队于某一换算后的公历日期越境。

title.en: Fuk’anggan reaches Taiwan; Zhuluo is renamed Jiayi
title.zh: 福康安赴台作战，诸罗改名嘉义

summary.en: In 1787, Fuk’anggan crossed to Taiwan during the Lin Shuangwen uprising. The Qing court renamed Zhuluo as Jiayi in recognition of the town’s defenders. Fighting continued into 1788. A conch sent with the commander preserves a box inscription recording its 1787 dispatch and 1788 return to the court.
summary.zh: 1787年，福康安在林爽文事件期间渡海赴台作战。清廷为褒奖诸罗守城者，将县名改为嘉义；战事延续至1788年。随统帅出行的法螺，其匣签记下1787年赐发、1788年缴回宫廷的经历。

dateNote.en: 1787 anchors the commander’s arrival and county renaming; the campaign ended in 1788. The map point represents Jiayi.
dateNote.zh: 1787年指统帅抵台与县名更改；战事结束于1788年。地图点代表嘉义。

note.en: Separated the 1787 arrival and renaming from the 1788 campaign endpoint, using museum chronology, the institutional historical map and the conch inscription.
note.zh: 据博物馆展览说明、学术机构历史地图及法螺匣签，分开1787年抵台、改名与1788年战事终结。

sources.title: The Lin Shuangwen campaign: Fangliao battle print

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 记1787年因褒奖守城者，将诸罗改名嘉义。

title.en: Qing conquest of Altishahr; the Ili command follows in 1762
title.zh: 清军征服回部；伊犁将军于1762年设立

summary.en: The Qing campaign against the Khoja leaders in Altishahr ended in 1759. This followed the earlier wars against the Dzungars. The court celebrated conquest in inscriptions and images. The office of the Ili general, responsible for military and administrative affairs north and south of the Tianshan, was established later, in the tenth lunar month of 1762.
summary.zh: 1759年，清军对回部大小和卓的战争结束，此前已发生对准噶尔的多次战争。清廷以碑文与图像纪念征服。统辖天山南北军政事务的伊犁将军一职，则到1762年农历十月才设立。

dateNote.en: 1759 marks the Altishahr campaign endpoint. The Ili general was established in 1762; the Ili map point is a regional reference, not the location of every campaign episode.
dateNote.zh: 1759年指回部战事终结；伊犁将军设于1762年。伊犁点位是区域参照，并非所有战事的发生地。

note.en: Separated the 1759 campaign endpoint from the 1762 administrative appointment; retained the inherited anchor, location and original text.
note.zh: 分开1759年战事终结与1762年设官，保留继承的时间锚点、位置与原文。

sources.title: Qianlong: chronology for 1759 and 1762
sources.evidenceNote: The chronology places the end of the Altishahr campaign in 1759 and establishment of the Ili general in the tenth lunar month of 1762. Court victory language is not adopted as a neutral description.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 年表分列1759年回部战事结束与1762年农历十月设立伊犁将军；不把宫廷报捷措辞作为中立叙述。

title.en: Liu Yuxi is demoted to Langzhou
title.zh: 刘禹锡被贬为朗州司马

summary.en: After the reform movement failed in 805, Liu Yuxi was demoted to Langzhou, present-day Changde. His next provincial appointment was at Lianzhou in 815. His Bamboo Branch Lyrics belong to a different setting: their preface describes hearing local singers at Jianping.
summary.zh: 805年革新失败后，刘禹锡被贬为朗州司马，朗州即今常德。815年，他再次出任连州刺史。《竹枝词》属于另一创作场景，其序写的是在建平听当地人联歌。

dateNote.en: 805 anchors the demotion, not the composition of Bamboo Branch Lyrics.
dateNote.zh: 805年指贬任朗州，不是《竹枝词》的创作年。

note.en: Separate the Langzhou exile from the Jianping song preface.
note.zh: 将朗州贬谪与建平《竹枝词》序的场景分开。

sources.title: Tang-period historical geography of Guangdong
sources.publisher: Xu Junming and Xu Xiaomei, Lingnan Wenshi; Guangdong cultural history portal
sources.evidenceNote: Explicit 805 demotion to Langzhou, then 815 Lianzhou.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 核对805年由连州改贬朗州，以及815年再任连州；不采用页面其他未经本次核对的历史概括。

sources.title: Bamboo Branch Lyrics, nine poems: preface
sources.evidenceNote: Preface explicitly locates inspiration at Jianping; editorial metadata gives 822 and Fengjie, not Langzhou 805.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 《竹枝词》序明确写到建平听歌，区别于朗州贬谪；页面822年的编年信息不用于改动条目锚点。

title.en: Liu Yuxi becomes prefect of Hezhou
title.zh: 刘禹锡出任和州刺史

summary.en: In 824, Liu Yuxi moved from Kuizhou to serve as prefect of Hezhou, in present-day Anhui. Local tradition connects his modest dwelling there with Inscription on My Humble Room, a text celebrating virtue over material luxury. Its authorship and place of composition have been debated.
summary.zh: 824年，刘禹锡由夔州转任和州刺史，和州位于今安徽。地方传说把他在此的简朴居所与《陋室铭》相联系，文章重德行而轻物质奢华；其作者归属和写作地点仍有学术争论。

dateNote.en: 824 dates the appointment; it is not an established composition date for the inscription.
dateNote.zh: 824年指任职，不是已确证的《陋室铭》作年。

note.en: Anchor the appointment and distinguish literary tradition from established chronology.
note.zh: 以任职为锚点，将文学传说与任职年代区分。

sources.title: Liu Yuxi: public service and literary tradition
sources.publisher: Nanfang Daily, republished by Guangdong discipline commission
sources.evidenceNote: 824 Hezhou appointment is stated separately from room anecdote introduced as tradition. Unrelated chronology on this newspaper page is not adopted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 文章将824年和州任职与“相传”的居室轶事分开；不采用页面其他未经核对的年代叙述。

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 卞孝萱提出作者归属异议，并讨论不同学术观点；据此说明存在争论，不裁定作者。

title.en: Fan Zhongyan takes charge of Yan prefecture’s frontier defence
title.zh: 范仲淹主持延州边防

summary.en: In 1040, Fan Zhongyan took charge of Yan prefecture during the war with Western Xia. The Songshi describes him reorganizing its troops and strengthening frontier positions. Dashun fort belonged to his later Qingzhou command: the Song Huiyao dates its construction to 1042.
summary.zh: 1040年，对西夏战争期间，范仲淹兼知延州。《宋史》记他整编州兵、加强边防；大顺城则属于此后庆州任上的建设，《宋会要辑稿》系其筑城于1042年。

dateNote.en: 1040 anchors the Yan posting, not Dashun’s construction or a dated autumn lyric.
dateNote.zh: 1040年指延州任职，不是大顺城筑城年，也不用于确定秋词作年。

note.en: Separate places and years; remove the unverified poem-composition claim.
note.zh: 区分地点与年代，移除未核实的作词时间。

sources.title: Songshi 314: Fan Zhongyan
sources.evidenceNote: Yan posting, reorganization and subsequent Qingzhou/Dashun sequence, not poem date.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 本传记延州任职、整编部队及此后庆州、大顺城的次序，不用于确定作词日期。

sources.title: Su Shunqin and Ouyang Xiu
sources.evidenceNote: Dates frontier appointment sequence to 1040.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 地方志文章明确把边防任职次序系于1040年。

sources.title: Song Huiyao Jigao 104: Dashun fort
sources.publisher: Song institutional records, later compilation; Wikisource transcription
sources.evidenceNote: Explicit Qingli 2 (1042), near Qingzhou Rouyuan, not the 1040 Yan marker.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 明确记庆历二年（1042年）在庆州柔远寨附近建大顺城，区别于1040年的延州任职。

title.en: Yu Qian begins his Henan and Shanxi administration
title.zh: 于谦开始巡抚河南、山西

summary.en: Yu Qian was appointed to oversee Henan and Shanxi in 1430. The Mingshi describes grain relief, support for displaced households and visits to the districts under his charge. It counts nineteen years in office, including interruptions for mourning, before his recall to Beijing in 1448.
summary.zh: 1430年，于谦受命巡抚河南、山西。《明史》记他发粮赈济、安置流民，并巡视所部；书中称其前后在任十九年，其间曾归乡治丧，1448年奉召入京。

dateNote.en: 1430 dates the appointment. The Mingshi’s nineteen-year account includes intervals away for mourning.
dateNote.zh: 1430年指任命；《明史》所述前后十九年任期中，包括离职归乡治丧的间隔。

note.en: Retain the sourced tenure as an attributed span; do not date the Two Sleeves Clear poem to 1430. The injustice cases in the biography precede this tenure in Jiangxi.
note.zh: 保留有来源的前后任期，不将“两袖清风”诗系于1430年；传记中的平反冤狱属于此前江西巡按。

sources.title: Mingshi 170: Yu Qian
sources.evidenceNote: Reports tenure, relief, nine-gate deployment and Desheng command; attributed figures are not independent headcounts.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 记述任期、赈济、九门部署及德胜门指挥；兵数作为史书记载加以归属，并非独立清点。

title.en: Yu Qian helps defend Beijing against Esen
title.zh: 于谦主持北京防御，抵御也先

summary.en: In 1449, Yu Qian organized Beijing’s defence against Esen’s Oirat army. The Mingshi reports 220,000 troops deployed outside the city’s nine gates, with Yu Qian and Shi Heng commanding at Desheng Gate. Its account describes fighting at several gates before Esen withdrew.
summary.zh: 1449年，于谦组织北京防御，抵御也先率领的瓦剌军。《明史》记二十二万军分列九门之外，于谦与石亨在德胜门督战；战事涉及多处城门，随后也先撤军。

dateNote.en: 1449 dates the defence. The reported 220,000 is a citywide deployment, not the force at Desheng Gate alone.
dateNote.zh: 1449年指北京保卫战；史书记载的二十二万是九门部署总数，不是德胜门一处兵力。

note.en: Attribute the troop figure and correct its geographic scope.
note.zh: 注明兵数出处，纠正其地理范围。

sources.title: Mingshi 170: Yu Qian
sources.evidenceNote: Reports tenure, relief, nine-gate deployment and Desheng command; attributed figures are not independent headcounts.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 记述任期、赈济、九门部署及德胜门指挥；兵数作为史书记载加以归属，并非独立清点。

title.en: Night Revels of Han Xizai: a Southern Tang story in later painting
title.zh: 韩熙载夜宴：后世绘画中的南唐故事

summary.en: Gu Hongzhong served as a painter at the Southern Tang court. A transmitted story says the ruler sent him to observe Han Xizai’s night parties and paint what he saw. Surviving copies and later adaptations turned the gathering into a lasting subject for figure painting. The Taipei scroll preserves the final scene in an old copy, while a Ming version relocates the dance into a garden.
summary.zh: 顾闳中曾任南唐宫廷画家。流传的故事称，君主派他观察韩熙载的夜宴并绘出所见。现存摹本与后世改绘使这一聚会成为人物画的长久题材。台北故宫旧摹卷保存末段场面，明代版本则将舞蹈移入庭园。

dateNote.en: 937–975 marks the Southern Tang setting. The party, original painting and surviving copy have no established exact year in these museum records. The inherited 960 date is retained in the review history.
dateNote.zh: 937—975年表示南唐背景。馆藏记录未确立夜宴、原作与现存摹本的具体年份；继承的960年保留在校订记录中。

note.en: Replaced an unsupported exact-year commission with the Southern Tang context. The surviving images are a copy and a later adaptation; their museum attributions, rather than catalogue titles alone, guide the account.
note.zh: 将未获核实的具体年份委托改为南唐背景。现存图像为摹本与后世改绘，叙述采用馆方鉴定说明，而非仅依据馆藏题名。

sources.title: The Night Revels of Han Hsi-tsai
sources.evidenceNote: The museum describes an old copy rather than Gu Hongzhong’s original, gives the Southern Tang context as 937–975, and presents the commission as a transmitted story.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 馆方说明这是旧摹本而非顾闳中原迹，以937—975年为南唐背景，并将奉命作画叙述为传说。

sources.title: Illustration of Han Hsi-tsai’s Evening Banquet
sources.evidenceNote: The attribution discussion identifies another Ming artist’s work under Tang Yin’s name and points to Ming furniture.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 鉴定说明认为此为其他明人附名唐寅之作，并指出画中为明代家具。

title.en: Qing armies enter Ili; Dawachi is defeated and captured
title.zh: 清军进入伊犁，达瓦齐败逃被俘

summary.en: In 1755, Qing forces advanced into Ili against the Dzungar ruler Dawachi. Ayusi, a Dzungar soldier serving the Qing, led a night attack near Gedeng. Dawachi fled south of the Tian Shan and was later captured by the ruler of Ush. Qianlong celebrated Ayusi’s service in a poem and commissioned Castiglione to paint him with a lance. The portrait preserves the Qing court’s account of victory.
summary.zh: 1755年，清军进入伊犁，进攻准噶尔统治者达瓦齐。投效清廷的准噶尔军人阿玉锡率队在格登附近夜袭。达瓦齐向天山以南逃走，后被乌什城主擒获。乾隆作歌表彰阿玉锡，并命郎世宁绘制其持矛像。这幅画保存了清廷对胜利的叙述。

dateNote.en: 1755 dates the campaign and commissioned portrait. The map point represents the Ili region, not the precise raid or capture site.
dateNote.zh: 1755年为本次战役与奉命绘像之年；地图点位仅示意伊犁地区，并非夜袭或被俘的确切地点。

note.en: Replaced the misleading English claim that Dawachi was destroyed with the documented defeat, flight and capture. Narrowed the account to the 1755 campaign and its court portrait.
note.zh: 将英文中达瓦齐被“摧毁”的误译改为有据可查的战败、逃走与被俘；叙述聚焦1755年战役及其宫廷纪功肖像。

sources.evidenceNote: Chinese catalogue, Qianlong 20 date and yihai inscription support 1755; an older English paragraph misprints 1775. The commentary records the raid, Dawachi’s flight and capture. Troop totals and hostile court labels are not adopted as independent facts.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 中文目录、乾隆二十年纪年与乙亥题记支持1755年；较旧英文简介误作1775年。研究说明记载夜袭、达瓦齐逃走及被俘；不将兵数和宫廷敌我称谓直接采用为独立事实。
